name: smwmusic-yume-nikki-poniko-s-room
title: Yume Nikki - Poniko's Room
description:
The simple yet calming theme playing in Poniko's Room when the light is turned on in the game Yume Nikki. Would work great in Yoshi's House and level's of that nature.

Special thanks to Pinci for the guiro sample and Wakana for helping me improve this port and his lovely Porting Tutorial!
